title: Framework Surface Family Crate Consolidation
description:
This is part of W8b ("Framework wave", family batch) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Key merges" → "Compiler...Surface" and "Architecture risks" (wasm-bindgen export/pkg-name changes ripple to every TS import site in the same commit).

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — read in FULL for the ~40 hard-won lessons across the whole initiative, especially: leftover-verification-overlay bugs (CRITICAL — has broken root `cargo metadata` at least 4 times, always clean up your own overlay + nested target/Cargo.lock before handoff), `#[path]` cumulative-resolution semantics (two valid conventions coexist — read carefully if you touch multi-level module nesting), DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools workaround, the registrar protocol, and the very recent M1-M9 mechanism-wave notes (search "M1 DONE" through "M6 done") — the registry/root-policy scripts now discover framework packages via `role = "framework"`.
3. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md` — taxonomy shape conventions, apply identically here (framework family instead of plugin).
4. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️library/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔣️taxonomy.json` and `🟦️discovery.ts` — shared vocabulary/discovery, read in full.
5. `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🗺️surface/` — read the CURRENT directory structure in full (5 impl dirs the plan mentions — paint/tiled-map/board-2d and 2 more, confirm by reading, don't assume names) before making any decisions.

YOUR TASK: consolidate `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🗺️surface/`'s 5 implementation dirs into ONE crate `semio-framework-surface` at `📦️packages/🦀️rust/` with the Shape V2 taxonomy conventions (`[package.metadata.semio] role = "framework"`). The plan specifies **ONE generated wasm wrapper** `@semio-tech/framework-surface-rs` should replace however many separate wasm-pack wrapper packages currently exist per sub-crate — find every current wasm-pack `pkg/` wrapper under this family and consolidate to one.

**Critical, explicit plan instruction**: "renderer-react import sites updated in lockstep" — before you rename/consolidate any wasm-bindgen export or npm package name, grep the WHOLE repo (not just this directory) for every TS import of the current package name(s)/export names, and update every import site in the SAME change. A wasm-bindgen rename that isn't updated everywhere at once will silently break renderer-react's build — this is flagged as a real architecture risk in the plan, not a hypothetical.

Preserve `[package.metadata.*]` verbatim where relevant (playground ports if any exist for this family — check), full test suite ported with baseline comparison, cross-cutting dependent search covering BOTH Cargo.toml path strings AND TS `import`/`require` lines (a repeatedly-confirmed gap class in this initiative).

VERIFICATION: `cargo check` (native + `--target wasm32-wasip2`), `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools cargo test --lib` with baseline comparison, `cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2 --profile wasm-release` + `bunx @bytecodealliance/jco transpile` (or whatever this repo's actual wasm-pack pipeline is — check an existing plugin's `📜️script.ts` for the exact command) to confirm the ONE new wasm wrapper actually builds and produces real output. Grep-confirm zero remaining references to the OLD per-sub-crate package names anywhere in the repo (Cargo.toml paths AND TS imports). Run the registry taxonomy check.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable, exclusive ownership of `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🗺️surface/**` + whatever renderer-react import-site files you must touch to keep it in lockstep):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, root package.json workspaces, nx.json, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, the registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, any plugin directory, or any OTHER framework family's directory beyond the narrow renderer-react import-site fixes this ticket explicitly requires.
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts (600s+).
- Delete any temporary verification overlay + nested target/Cargo.lock BEFORE closing your ticket.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` with a full summary and file list, plus a registrar-handoff block. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of the consolidated crate structure, the wasm wrapper unification, every renderer-react import site you had to fix, and your verification results.
